q: Coding agents increasingly undertake development tasks in mature enterprise repositories
r: Include: new benchmark (PACE-Bench) with a controlled model-scaffold comparison on feature-level PRD implementation, so it contributes to the evaluation method.

q: extends the current variety of codingagent benchmarks to a multi-turn setting with different user personas
r: EC6: the benchmark is built on SWE-Bench style tasks, so the evaluated task is issue repair.

q: We used Claude Code to migrate ten PyTorch research projects from GPUs to TPUs
r: EC6: a specialised-domain task (GPU-to-TPU migration of research code), neither feature-level building from requirements nor an evaluation-method contribution.
Include: secondary study of how agentic coding evaluations control model and harness, so the contribution is the evaluation method.

q: we develop a scalable pipeline that mines real-world repositories
r: EC6: the benchmark is mined from PR pairs (change and later defect fix), i.e. SWE-bench style repair of repository tasks.

q: We evaluate two representative harness self-evolution methods across three software engineering benchmarks
r: EC6: harness self-evolution evaluated on SWE-bench style benchmarks, i.e. issue repair, not feature-level building.

q: moves beyond synthetic isolated tasks toward persistent, runtimeobservable evaluation of agentic models under realistic engineering environments
r: Include: new assessment framework with long-horizon compiler-construction projects and cost, quality and efficiency metrics for 15 models on one backend.

q: For code generation, we use release v6 of the code-generation lite subset of LiveCodeBench (LCB), which contains 1,055 problems
r: EC6: tasks are LiveCodeBench problems and code review, so function-level generation and review, not feature-level development, and persona study adds no evaluation method.

q: We study how token cost in agentic coding varies across programming languages, controlling for problem difficulty
r: Include: controlled comparison of coding agents and models with cost metrics and trajectory analysis, so the evaluation method is the contribution (tasks are small, borderline).
Include: new benchmark and evaluation protocol for iterative web UI coding agents (frontend code changes), a contribution to the evaluation method.
